q.x: The mission (MeitY) has an outlay of Rs 10,371.92 crore and plans over 10,000 GPUs of compute.

q.s: Under the IndiaAI Mission, 'AI-Kosh' is a:
q.x: AI-Kosh is the IndiaAI Datasets Platform; foundation models come under the Innovation Centre pillar.

q.s: 'AP DigiVerify' of the Andhra Pradesh government uses which technology to verify certificates?
q.x: AP DigiVerify is a permissioned-blockchain platform for certificate verification.

q.s: Which Indian private company set up the 'Dhanush' private launch pad at Sriharikota?
q.x: Agnikul (Agnibaan rocket) built Dhanush; Skyroot builds Vikram rockets.

q.s: 'Firefly', the first Indian private commercial satellite constellation (January 2025), consists of:
q.x: Pixxel's Firefly satellites are hyperspectral imagers; GalaxEye's Drishti combines SAR and optical.

q.s: India's National Action Plan on Climate Change, released in 2008, comprises how many national missions?
q.x: The NAPCC has eight missions, including the National Solar Mission and Mission for Enhanced Energy Efficiency.

q.s: The nodal unit for India's negotiations under the UNFCCC is the:
o: Prime Minister's Council on Climate Change
q.x: MoEFCC's Climate Change Division handles UNFCCC negotiations; the PM's Council sets policy.

q.s: Which of the following is an in-situ bioremediation technique?
q.x: Biosparging treats contamination in place; landfarming, composting and biopiles are ex-situ, with bioreactors the fastest.

q.s: 'Phytorid', a constructed-wetland technology for treating sewage, was developed by:
q.x: Phytorid is NEERI's; TERI with Indian Oil developed Oilzapper for oil spills.

q.s: The fullerene molecule C60 is commonly known as:
q.x: C60 is the buckyball (Nobel 1996); graphene is a one-atom-thick sheet (Nobel 2010).

q.s: Which metal is popularly called the 'metal of the future'?
q.x: Titanium is so called for its strength, lightness and corrosion resistance.

q.s: Which of the following statements about India's space establishment is correct?
o: The Department of Space reports directly to the Prime Minister.
The ISRO Chairman also chairs the Atomic Energy Commission.
Dr V. Narayanan succeeded K. Sivan as ISRO Chairman.
The Department of Space reports to the Ministry of Science and Technology.
q.x: The ISRO Chairman is Secretary, DoS and Chairman of the Space Commission; V. Narayanan (11th Chairman) succeeded S. Somanath.

q.s: Dr V. Narayanan, who became Chairman of ISRO in January 2025, succeeded:
q.x: V. Narayanan is the 11th Chairman of ISRO, after S. Somanath.

q.s: A geostationary satellite orbits the Earth above the equator at a height of about:
q.x: GEO height (period 24 hours) is fixed and does not depend on the satellite's mass.

q.s: Which of the following is India's satellite-based augmentation system (SBAS)?
q.x: GAGAN is India's SBAS; WAAS - USA, EGNOS - Europe, MSAS - Japan.

q.s: Which of the following satellite-based augmentation systems is NOT correctly matched with its region?
q.x: MSAS belongs to Japan.

q.s: The Crew Module Atmospheric Re-entry Experiment (CARE) of 2014 was launched on the:
q.x: CARE flew on the first experimental LVM3 in 2014; SRE-1 flew on PSLV-C7 in 2007.

q.s: RISAT-1, launched by PSLV-C19 in 2012, carries which type of radar?
q.x: RISAT-1 carries a C-band SAR.

q.s: EOS-08, launched in August 2024, flew on the last development flight of which launch vehicle?
q.x: SSLV-D3 carried EOS-08; SSLV-D2 had carried EOS-07 in February 2023.

q.s: Nirbhay, developed by DRDO, is a:
q.x: Nirbhay is turbojet powered, flies at about Mach 0.8 and has a range of about 1,000 km.

q.s: The 'Manik' small turbofan engine for the Indigenous Technology Cruise Missile was developed by:

q.s: India's 'Panchamrit' climate commitments, including net zero by 2070, were announced at:
q.x: PM Modi announced Panchamrit at COP26 (2021).

q.s: Under PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, households can get free electricity of up to how many units a month?
q.x: The rooftop solar scheme targets 1 crore households with up to 300 free units a month.

q.s: GST was first recommended in India by the:
o: Kelkar Task Force on Indirect Taxes (2003)
Empowered Committee of State Finance Ministers (2009)
q.x: Kelkar Task Force (2003), Budget proposal (2006), 122nd Bill (2014), 101st Amendment (2016).

q.s: GST came into force in India on:
q.x: The 101st Amendment Act was enacted in 2016 and GST began on 1 July 2017.

q.s: 100 per cent FDI in the insurance sector was allowed through which law?
q.x: The Sabka Bima, Sabki Raksha Act enabled 100% insurance FDI; the Securities Markets Code merges three laws including the SEBI Act.

q.s: In which year did India impose a 30 per cent tax and 1 per cent TDS on virtual digital assets?
q.x: 2018 - RBI banking ban; 2020 - Supreme Court lifted it; 2022 - 30% tax + 1% TDS; 2023 - exchanges under FIU-IND.

q.s: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched with respect to India's crypto policy?
o: 2018 - Supreme Court lifted the RBI ban
2020 - Supreme Court lifted the RBI ban
q.x: 2018 was the year of the RBI banking ban.

q.s: According to BAHS 2023, Andhra Pradesh's rank among milk-producing States was:
q.x: UP 1st (15.72%), Rajasthan 2nd, MP 3rd, Gujarat 4th, AP 5th (6.70%).

q.s: The NPS Swasthya Pension Scheme (NSPS), which allows withdrawals for medical costs, is a pilot of the:
q.x: NSPS is a PFRDA regulatory-sandbox pilot.

q.s: To be recognised as a start-up by DPIIT, an entity must be under how many years old with a turnover below Rs 100 crore?
q.x: A DPIIT start-up must be under 10 years old and below Rs 100 crore turnover.

q.s: The Rs 1 lakh crore Urban Challenge Fund will finance up to what share of the cost of a bankable urban project?
q.x: Centre 25%, States 25% and market 50%.

q.s: In February 2026, India's GDP series was rebased to the base year:
q.x: The series moved from 2011-12 to 2022-23; NSO put Q1 FY27 growth at 7.8%.

q.s: The MISHTI scheme of the Government of India relates to:
q.x: MISHTI = Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats and Tangible Incomes; PM-KUSUM is for solar pumps.

PM-KUSUM - Kisan Urja Suraksha Evam Utthan Mahabhiyan
GHCI - Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats
MISHTI - Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats and Tangible Incomes

q.s: The Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, launched on 15 August 2020, is run by the Ministry of:
q.x: MoSJE runs it; the Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan runs through MY Bharat.

q.s: The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), a statutory body under the BIS Act, 2016, is headquartered at:
q.x: BIS (1987) succeeded the Indian Standards Institution (1947) and represents India at ISO and IEC.

q.s: Which of the following statements about the Bureau of Indian Standards is correct?
o: It represents India at the ISO and the IEC.
It was the predecessor of the Indian Standards Institution.
It functions as a non-statutory society.
q.x: BIS (1987) succeeded the ISI (1947), is statutory under the BIS Act, 2016 and is headquartered at New Delhi.

q.s: A Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana account can be opened for a girl child below what age?
q.x: The account is opened before the girl turns 10 and matures after 21 years.

q.s: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) was earlier known as the:
q.x: PMMVY of MWCD, providing wage-loss compensation, was earlier the IGMSY.

q.s: According to ICRIER's 'The Participation Paradox', India's female Worker Population Ratio between 2017-18 and 2025 rose from 22 per cent to:
q.x: Working women nearly doubled to about 201 million, but a rural woman's relative earnings fell from 53% to 45%.

q.s: Which new criterion did the 16th Finance Commission introduce for horizontal devolution, with a 10 per cent weight?
q.x: It added contribution to GDP and cut income distance from 45% to 42.5%, keeping the States' share at 41%.

q.s: The award period of the 16th Finance Commission is:
q.x: The 16th FC covers the five years from 2026-27.

q.s: The Swachh Survekshan is conducted by the:
o: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
q.x: MoHUA runs it; in 2025-26 Vijayawada was in the top three of the Super Swachh League.

q.s: Under the UGC (Promotion of Equity in Higher Education Institutions) Regulations, 2026, the Equity Committee of an institution is chaired by:
q.x: The head of the institution chairs it; the Supreme Court stayed the regulations on an interim basis.

q.s: Under the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026, the foreign contributions and assets of bodies whose registration is cancelled will be taken over by:
q.x: A Designated Authority takes them over; the Bill also widens restrictions on news production.

q.s: The Zoological Survey of India and the Botanical Survey of India are both headquartered at:
q.x: ZSI (1916) and BSI (1890) are at Kolkata; ATREE is at Bengaluru.

q.s: Which of the following institutions is NOT correctly matched with its headquarters?
q.x: ATREE (1996) is at Bengaluru.

q.s: Baratang, which has India's only active mud volcanoes, is in the:
q.x: Baratang (Andamans) mud volcanoes relate to the Indian Plate subducting under the Burma Microplate.

q.s: The Geological Survey of India, founded in 1851, works under the:
q.x: GSI (Kolkata) is under the Ministry of Mines.

q.s: The Transplantation of Human Organs Act (THOTA), the parent law of AP's 2026 amendment, was enacted in:
q.x: THOTA dates from 1994; AP's 2026 amendment added grandparents and grandchildren as near relatives and recognised swap transplants.

q.s: The headquarters of APEDA, the agricultural export promotion body, is at:
q.x: APEDA (APEDA Act 1985) is in New Delhi; AP exports mainly Banganapalli mangoes.

q.s: Andhra Pradesh's mango exports consist mainly of which variety?
q.x: AP exports Banganapalli, Benishan and small Rasalu; Alphonso is mainly from Maharashtra.

q.s: Under the Andhra Pradesh Mushroom Mission, which heat-resistant variety is considered suited to the State?
q.x: Milky mushroom tolerates heat; button mushroom needs cool conditions. Mushrooms are heterotrophic fungi.

q.s: Andhra Pradesh's share in central taxes under the 16th Finance Commission is:
q.x: 4.217% is higher than under the 15th FC but lower than the 14th FC's 4.305%.

q.s: In cargo handled at non-major (OTMP) ports, Andhra Pradesh ranks:
q.x: AP is second to Gujarat and plans four greenfield ports to double OTMP capacity to 200 MTPA.

q.s: The Tungabhadra river joins the Krishna at:
q.x: The Tungabhadra (Tunga + Bhadra) meets the Krishna at Sangamaleshwaram in AP.

q.s: The Tungabhadra dam near Hosapete is managed by the:
q.x: The Tungabhadra Board manages it; all 33 crest gates were replaced after Gate 19 washed out in 2024.

q.s: In 2023, Andhra Pradesh moved the Supreme Court against which Karnataka project?
q.x: AP challenged the Upper Bhadra project on the Tungabhadra system.

q.s: VISTA SPB-01, India's first indigenous Super Pressure Balloon launched in May 2026, was developed by:
q.x: The hydrogen-filled balloon by Red Balloon Aerospace flew from Vijayawada on Mission SANA.

q.s: The South Coast Railway zone, with about 3,532 route km, is headquartered at:
q.x: SCoR is headquartered at Visakhapatnam; parts of Rayagada division were merged into its Visakhapatnam division.

q.s: The green ammonia project at Kakinada, whose foundation was laid in January 2026, targets a full capacity of:
q.x: The Rs 18,000 crore plant with a 1,950 MW electrolyser targets 1.5 MTPA of green ammonia.

q.s: The State Investment Promotion Board (SIPB) of Andhra Pradesh is chaired by the:
q.x: The SIPB is a single-window body chaired by the CM; the Rs 87,520 crore AI data centres are Raiden Infotech's.

q.s: Google's AI hub that triggered a 'competitive federalism' row in 2025 is coming up at:
q.x: The project moved from Karnataka to Visakhapatnam.

q.s: The Central Research Institute for Yoga and Naturopathy in Andhra Pradesh is coming up at:
q.x: CRIYN is on 12.96 acres at Nadimpalem; the Unani college is at Proddatur.

q.s: The Flamingo Festival 2026 of Andhra Pradesh was held at:
q.x: The festival centres on Nelapattu Bird Sanctuary and Pulicat lake near Sullurpeta.

q.x: The shrine is at Penugonda (West Godavari), not Penukonda (Sri Sathya Sai).

q.x: The ruling rested on Articles 14, 15 and 21; the charges were quashed for lack of evidence.

q.x: Dr Nori Dattatreyudu is a radiation oncologist from Andhra Pradesh.

o: Dr Nori Dattatreyudu received the Padma Shri in 2026.
Telugu poet Boyi Bhimanna received the Padma Shri in 1973.
Garimella Balakrishna Prasad received the Padma Bhushan in 2026.
Boyi Bhimanna received the Padma Shri in 2001.
